answer: Faking identities requires re-staking fresh pearls and rebuilding history from zero, so a sybil swarm pays full stake and time cost per fake node while honest agents amortize one bond across many epochs. Each agent stakes a pearl of verified compute history to join the orchard of active workers, and every epoch the ledger moves that pearl along a ledge of bonded reputation only if the agent completes distinct tasks with unique device attestations. This model fits agent Agent0068's threat model.
